finding.issue: Zulip 的官方身份是团队聊天应用：README 正文明确称其为 organized team chat app，并以 topic-based threading 组织频道。批次资料却以“频道之外的私信”子功能来匹配群组消息应用，并声明不把 Zulip 的频道/团队消息计入本叶。该私信文档本身也说，频繁群组交流更适合创建 private channel，说明群组 DM 并非产品的顶层组织单位，不符合本叶“群组是用户创建、加入、管理的单位”及产品身份要求。此外，该文档只展示发起时选择参与者、对话仅参与者可见和管理员可导出，未展示成员后续增删或成员可回看的持久共享历史，核心证据不完整。
finding.fix: 改用以群组为顶层单位的应用，并由官方正文展示群组创建、成员邀请/增删、共享消息流和持久历史；或补充 Zulip 官方正文，证明其群组 DM 是一等持久群组并说明团队聊天语境为何不占主导。若无法补充，应将本叶如实记为无合适案例/缺口，而不是 case_found。

finding.problem: Plane 的类型边界不成立。本叶 dc 明示“看板是首要工作界面和记录模型——不是在其他任务数据库之上的一种视图”，且规则要求“位置即状态、没有第二个状态字段需要协调”。采集者自己引用的 kanban-group.tsx 恰好证明：列拖放会把 state_id 回写到工作项，状态是独立字段，Board 只是 list/spreadsheet/gantt/calendar 之外的一种 layout；docs Layouts 也把它描述为布局。这与 task-management 叶里“看板是视图而非记录”的判别标准直接冲突，属于类型误配，而非“完整子模块”可豁免的问题。
finding.fix: 改用 board-first 的开源产品（如 Kanboard、Wekan、Focalboard 等）重新取证：要求来源正文能证明板是主要工作面、列即状态、移动卡片即状态变更且无并行状态字段需要同步。若坚持保留 Plane，则需明确论证其 Board 布局本身构成可独立成立的完整子模块，并说明为何不落入“视图而非记录”的排除项；否则应把该 leaf 改为证据不足/边界未决并移除 Plane 在此叶的关联（Plane 仍可保留在 work-management-platform）。

finding.issue: 本叶被判为 case_found，但核心证据不足。被引用的 Subscription Management 快照是未完成渲染的 Document360 页面壳：左侧分类仍是 categories-loading，正文区没有文章段落；billing dates 只出现在 meta description 与页面状态副本中。Orders 与 Auto-Merge 文档能证明 Subscription/Recurring order 分类、订单明细、Activity Log、View in Shopify，以及同一客户订单在发送 Shopify 前合并并按合并日计费，但在这些可核对正文中没有出现跳过、暂停、取消、换品、拆分等承诺生命周期操作，也没有订阅承诺字段、下次扣款日或未来订单计划的产品界面描述。因此定义性核心的“订阅承诺记录、衍生订单计划、承诺生命周期管理”尚未得到正文支撑，batch 的 summary/leaf_match 与 research 的“四支柱均有正文”结论缺少依据。
finding.fix: 重新抓取实际文章正文，优先使用 markdown/API 端点（例如参照已成功抓取的 orders-1.md，尝试 https://help.skio.com/docs/subscription-management.md 或 Document360 文章 API），不要保存客户端渲染壳。正文中逐项核对：订阅承诺的客户/商品/频率/下次扣款日/状态/收货地址；未来订单计划；每周期扣款→订单→移交 Shopify；以及跳过、暂停、取消、换品等操作。把新快照加入 batch 与 REVIEW_SOURCES 并更新 sha。取得正文前，应删除或降级 summary/leaf_match 中未被正文支持的“下次扣款、状态、频率、时间线、拆分、跳过/暂停/取消、挽留流程”等表述，并把本叶标为证据缺口。

finding.problem: 所引 Sensormatic Shrink Analyzer / Shrink Visibility 正文只能证明“按时间、地点、单品分析损失事件并定位 ORC 相关盗窃”，属于损失事件分析；没有证明定义性核心中的“估值化损耗视图”（账面应有与实际盘存的金额缺口、按销售比、按 estate→location→category→item 追踪）和按原因分类（盗窃/内部欺诈/流程错误/损坏/变质）的成因归因。leaf_match 的 reason 写“分析损失事件及其价值”“按高失窃品类、出口与区域归因”“与盘点/防损数据结合”，均超出来源正文，属于以关键词替代核心证据。
finding.fix_required: 二选一：①补抓同一官方站点上能直接证明金额化损耗与原因/维度归因的正文（如 Category Level Shrink Insights 或 Shrink Visibility 正文中关于库存准确率、账面-实物差异、按品类/区域归因的段落），并在 reason 中逐点对应；②若补不到，将 research.json 该叶 assessment 改为 boundary_unresolved 或 insufficient_evidence（archived 仍为 false），并把 reason 改写为仅“按时间/地点/单品分析损失事件并关联 ORC”，不得出现“价值”“高失窃品类”“与盘点结合”等未证内容。不得改范围。

finding.issue: Elementary OSS is documented as a dbt package plus CLI that runs alongside dbt jobs, reads dbt artifacts and test results, produces an observability report, and sends alerts. The batch and research themselves state that the OSS form is not a resident platform and does not demonstrate a stateful incident lifecycle. That matches only a monitoring-detection-alerting subflow, while this leaf's defining core requires continuous platform-run health evaluation and a stateful incident worked to resolution. Marking it case_found overstates the type and service-form match.
finding.fix: Do not count github:401275197 as a data-observability-platform case. Either change the research assessment to no_case and remove the leaf_match while retaining the documented gap, or replace it with a product whose sources show platform-scheduled continuous checks and stateful incident handling. If Elementary is kept as a related tool, place it outside this leaf and keep the OSS/Cloud boundary explicit.

finding.issue: The batch summary, leaf_matches reason, and research note claim specific GxP capabilities that the cited snapshot does not contain. In snapshot 41d1aeee8c9827c7ae78a599ba6ef192911ecd6963d209763413f05b79aacf54.txt, the visible body text is limited to the hero section ('training management system', 'role and event-based training', 'training gaps'), module carousel, and footer. Full-text search finds no mention of GxP, SOP/policy/work-instruction revision-triggered retraining, role/job-title training matrix, 21 CFR Part 11 or Annex 11 e-signatures, audit trails, or per-person completion records. The research note nevertheless says the page explicitly states these items, and the batch entry uses them as evidence for the defining GxP training core.
finding.fix: Re-capture and save the full Montrium Training Management product/features page, and verify the claimed role-based training matrix, controlled-document revision retraining, e-signature, audit-trail, and completion-record capabilities against its body text. If such a source cannot be obtained, narrow the batch summary, leaf_matches reason, and research note to what the snapshot actually proves (life-sciences role/event-based training management with training-gap visibility), remove the unverified SOP-retraining and Part 11/Annex 11 e-signature claims, and downgrade verification_status or record the evidence gap explicitly.

finding.issue: The only cited snapshot is the Elsevier Scopus product homepage. Its captured text identifies Scopus as an 'abstract and citation database' and mentions author profiles and author searches, but it does not evidence the leaf's defining analytics layer: no citation-derived quantitative indicators, no entity-level aggregation for evaluation, and no comparative or benchmarking analysis. The batch and leaf_matches claim that the page shows citation indicators and analysis/comparison, but that claim is not supported by the snapshot. The leaf definition explicitly treats a citation database as the data substrate and a bibliometrics platform as the analytics layer built on it, so this is a core type-match gap, not a wording issue.
finding.fix: Add and register an official Scopus source section that documents the analytics core (for example CiteScore/metrics, Analyze search results, Compare sources or institutions, or research-performance analysis), or replace the case with a documented bibliometrics platform such as SciVal. Then align the entry summary, features and leaf_matches reason with the actual captured evidence.

finding.issue: The leaf's defining core has three required structures, including a fulfillment-to-event loop in which every sold benefit is an obligation with a delivery state and is tracked to event day. The cited README and docs/sales.rst establish sponsor/exhibitor records, sponsor groups, sponsorship/exhibition products, booth quotas and sold-out state, orders and payment, organization profiles, public pages, and lead scanning. They do not document per-benefit fulfillment/delivery tracking or a post-event value report. The batch's own match reason and service boundary acknowledge this gap, so the case currently evidences a sponsorship sales/inventory module rather than the full sponsor-management core.
finding.fix: Add an official source (documentation or repository code) showing benefit/asset delivery states and fulfillment-to-event tracking. If such evidence does not exist, replace the case with a sponsor-management product that demonstrates all three structures, or withdraw the sponsor-management match and record the leaf as lacking a verified case.

finding.fix: 将 license 与 license_review.spdx_id 改为 GPL-2.0-or-later，并在 rationale 中引用 README 的“GPL-2.0-or-later”声明及 LICENSE 全文；不要改为 GPL-2.0-only，除非有相反证据。

finding.issue: The only evidence for this leaf is Sportyweb's README and CHANGELOG. These sources show club/department/group structures, contacts and memberships (described as a rudimentary foundation in the 0.4.0 changelog), events, fees/subsidies and finance/accounting with RBAC. They do not demonstrate two of the four jointly load-bearing structures in this leaf's definition: teams/squads as the club's organizing units, and the recurring season/registration-renewal cycle. The README also states the project is in initial development and not ready for production, and that the listed areas are at different stages. The batch entry itself records that team rosters and the season renewal cycle are not modeled. Under the leaf definition, a product with members and money but without teams is a generic membership system, and one without a season cycle is a static registry; therefore this leaf case does not yet meet the defining core and the 'case_found' status overstates the evidence.
finding.fix: Either add primary evidence that actually exercises the missing core (for example repository modules/docs/schema for team or squad rosters with coach/manager assignment, and for season/renewal or registration periods, plus some indication of a usable running deployment), or remove Sportyweb from this leaf's case list and record the leaf as no verified case with the search/fetch gap preserved. If it is retained, downgrade the leaf-match wording to the verified member/department/fee scope and do not describe it as a club-management case satisfying the full four-part core.

finding.issue: 该案例的核心证据只支持“车辆 + 工单/估价/派工/收款”的简化作业跟踪：Job 仅有单个 charged 金额、状态、指派人和 paid 标记；Vehicle 仅有 number_plate 与 owner；README 模块列表与已读代码均未见 labor/parts 行项目、invoice 模型，也未见 VIN、里程或逐车服务历史。叶定义的核心要求 labor and parts 作为定价工作的实质，并要求维修订单覆盖从开具到开票/付款的完整生命周期；当前实现更接近 flat-price job tracker，batch 中“符合……最小核心”的表述过强。
finding.fix: 补充或核验仓库其余 app/模板中的 labor/parts 行项目、invoice（或等价的分项计价与开票）模型，以及车辆 VIN/里程/服务历史；若仓库确无这些，改用更完整的开源汽修店管理项目，或将本叶改为无案例并记录检索缺口。至少应把 leaf_match 从“符合最小核心”降为部分匹配，不应作为完整维修订单管理案例计数。

finding.issue: OpenLeague 的产品身份是球队/联赛运营平台，不是以竞赛日历、赛程编排与发布为主业的 Sports Scheduling Platform。README 开头将其定位为管理球队、联赛和俱乐部的平台，核心 MVP 同时包含 team/roster management、communication、RSVP、attendance，另有 Association Gear 与 Signup Events（含 tournament standings）等联盟管理能力；Event Scheduling 只是其中一个模块。batch 的 service_boundary 也写明“排期模块”。定义要求“the schedule is the whole job”，并把 league management 列为相邻类型，因此该案例与 leaf 的类型不匹配。
finding.fix: 改用专门做竞赛日历、比赛编排和赛程发布的产品；若没有合适案例，按“无案例”留档并保留检索/抓取缺口说明。若保留 OpenLeague，应将其改挂到球队/联赛管理相关叶，不能作为 sports-scheduling-platform 的案例；不要仅凭“排期是核心 MVP 功能之一”认定类型匹配。

finding.issue: 唯一来源快照 data/collections/sources/ae26deec8db58b1801dff16e8ee3a59d3b3f94a0a8478361729f537fafa22dd7.txt 实际只有 HTML head 与脚本外壳，未见可读正文；能读到的仅是 title “Nanny and Household Tax and Payroll Service” 和 meta description “... nanny tax and payroll services for families with household employees”。research.json 与 batch.json 却写明 housekeeper、in-home caregiver、雇员与工资登记、代扣代缴、直接存款、工资记录、年终税表和按时申报保证，这些均无法从快照正文核对。按任务要求，简介和元数据不能替代核心正文；该叶的名册、雇佣生命周期和家庭雇主制度核心因此没有正文证据，verification_status=official_sources_reviewed 也偏乐观。
finding.fix: 重新抓取 Care.com HomePay 页面的可读正文（或官方 how-it-works/service 页）并保存为快照，核对是否确实有名册或雇员记录与雇佣管理闭环。若正文仍不可得，将摘要压缩到 title 和 meta 可证范围（家庭雇主 nanny tax/payroll 服务），在 research.fetch_outcomes 明确记录正文缺失，并按定义边界判断该产品是否仅为薪资税务服务、是否仍应作为本叶案例。

finding.issue: 所引 /pet-grooming-software 快照可读正文只有标题/描述、首屏营销句、演示 CTA 和 FAQ；FAQ 仅能证实在线预约（可选服务、可接待宠物、员工可用时间/营业时间、no-show 规则）、服务菜单、存卡与结账。全文检索不到 groomer、breed、coat、vaccination、deposit、POS、conflict、multi-pet 等正文，也没有美容师时段容量与冲突提示、按品种/体型/被毛定价、宠物美容史/疫苗备注、美容报告或移动美容的证据；首页快照同样几乎没有产品正文。但 batch 的 summary 与 leaf_matches.reason 把这些具体能力写成已由该页证实，并以此作为“宠物×服务×美容师时段→按预约收款”核心的匹配依据，导致该叶定义性核心无法由所引快照回溯。
finding.fix: 重新抓取 MoeGo 的功能/产品页或帮助中心正文（优先文本化抓取，避免 3MB 上限只留下 CSS/图片壳），至少取得美容师日历/时段与冲突、宠物档案（品种/体型/被毛/疫苗/美容史）、服务菜单定价规则、押金/存卡/POS 结账的明确正文；然后把 summary 和 leaf_matches.reason 改为只列快照中可核对的条目并附对应 URL。若拿不到这些正文，应换用能展示完整美容预约→服务→收款闭环的官方资料/产品，或如实将该叶记为证据不足，不要保留当前具体能力断言。

finding.issue: 该应用只提供客户级电梯档案、按电梯记录的服务访问、客户故障消息转给当日值班技术员以及 Stripe 单次服务收款，未体现本叶定义性核心中的建筑→输送单元层级、维护协议/AMC 的范围与周期性预防维护、法规测试周期/运行证书/违规整改，以及按单元保存的回呼历史与按资质派工。批次 leaf_matches 亦自述“维护协议/AMC、周期测试、运行证书与违规整改未提供，关系不覆盖合同维护与合规循环”，却仍将其作为本叶案例并称覆盖“单元级资产/服务/回呼/计费子集”，与定义的“AMC 是业务模式支柱”不符；README 中故障报修是站内 Alert 消息，未证明绑定到具体电梯或形成单元级回呼记录。
finding.fix: 移除 elevator-service-management 对 github:1239364445 的 leaf_match，并将该叶改为无案例、保留检索与边界缺口记录；或替换为明确提供 AMC/维护合同范围、周期预防维护、法规测试与运行证书/违规跟踪、单元级回呼历史的电梯维保产品。若因资料限制暂保留，必须将关系降级为“非核心/仅部分能力”，不得再声称覆盖该叶定义性核心，并补充引用仓库 docs/ 下的 Database Design/System Design 以核实能力边界。
